requirements: Is there exactly one grid of 4 columns by 4 rows showing 16 distinct items?
Does each item occupy its own square cell without touching or crossing any cell edges?
Is each item centered in its cell and filling about 70 percent of the cell with clear empty margin around it?
Are the 16 items presented in the exact order listed from left to right top to bottom starting with the red hair clip in position 1?
Is the first item a shiny red hair clip with a small bow shown open?
Is the second item a yellow gingham dress with round collar and puffed sleeves shown laid flat?
Is the fifth item a big round golden chocolate chip cookie with a thin curl of steam?
Is the eighth item one glossy red hot chili pepper with a green stem curved like a hook?
Is the thirteenth item a small round pie in a tin made of dark mud with a flower in the middle?
Is the sixteenth item one lonely striped sock shown soggy and drooping with a drip at the toe?
